letter_deductions.why: Ratio should be 5,000/8,000 = 0.625 (lower of room 0.625 and ICU 0.833): 77,950 x 0.375 = 29,231; insurer used a 50% cut (77,950 x 0.5).
Method right; base reduced by the wrong proportionate cut. 5% of 84,419.

notes: Both room and ICU exceed caps; per DECISIONS #2 the lower ratio is applied. Drugs & IV fluids treated as medicines (exempt); consumables, implants, diagnostics are proportioned (DECISIONS #1). Pre-hospitalisation bill not proportioned (Note 2 covers expenses "incurred at the Hospital"). The insurer's 38,975 equals exactly 50% of the non-medicine charges; no ratio in the documents gives 0.5.
